name: labelling-workbench
description: Browser-based practice tool for writing and checking drug labels: PLR prescribing information, patient labelling, carton and container labels and generic labelling, for fictional products.

scripts.pack: python3 tools/packs/us.py && python3 tools/packs/core.py && python3 tools/packs/eu.py && python3 tools/packs/in.py && python3 tools/packs/intl.py
scripts.test: node tests/checks.test.mjs && node tests/workflow.test.mjs && node tests/core.test.mjs && node tests/eu.test.mjs && node tests/in.test.mjs && node tests/intl.test.mjs
